svg.title: Ledger: a year of public work
svg.desc: Ledger as of 2026-10-26: 531 public contributions in the last twelve months, drawn as a perpetual calendar with one spoke per week and one ring per weekday. 67 active days, a longest run of 14 days, busiest day 53 contributions on 2026-10-07, 37 public repositories. Languages by bytes: PHP 25.7%, Vue 20.4%, Python 15.6%, CSS 9.5%, TypeScript 9.2%, JavaScript 7.6%, Other 12.1%. Redrawn weekly, not live.
